cohort: 57 patients with uterine atony during cesarean delivery at Udonthani Hospital, Udonthani, Thailand, from January 2009 to December 2017
finding: The uterine flexion suture technique, modified from the B-Lynch suture, was found to be a quick, inexpensive, and effective treatment for uterine atony during cesarean section.
mod_finding: This study describes a uterine flexion suture technique for treating uterine atony during cesarean section.
